'''Destato Island''' was an island on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was home to [[Shey Tapani University/Legends|Shey Tapani University]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
